indication_area: Oncology (solid and hematologic; esophageal squamous cell carcinoma, NSCLC, cHL)
geography: Worldwide (BeiGene tislelizumab net product revenue; China-led)

first_approval_evidence.quote: In December 2019, our anti-PD-1 antibody tislelizumab received approval from the NMPA as a treatment for patients with classical Hodgkin's Lymphoma ("cHL") who have received at least two prior therapies and we launched tislelizumab in China in March 2020.

launch_evidence.quote: Product revenue for tislelizumab reflects sales since its launch in China in March 2020, including launch inventory build at distributors.

search_log: Listed every filing for CIK 1651308 (BeiGene, now BeOne Medicines) via data.sec.gov/submissions; fetched every 10-Q/10-K filed 2020-04 to 2026-09.

First to third quarters from the 'Tislelizumab' / 'TEVIMBRA' row of the product revenue, net by product table in each Form 10-Q (thousands of U.S. dollars); fourth quarters derived as the Form 10-K full year less the 10-Q nine months. first_approval_year is the December 2019 NMPA (China) approval, which preceded the March 2024 FDA approval cited in approval_evidence; first_approval_evidence quotes BeiGene's own statement. The 2020Q1 10-Q prints the prior-year quarter as a dash, so 2020Q1 (the March 2020 launch quarter) is the first quarter of sales.
Prior-year check: the prior-year comparative column of 17 quarterly quotes equals the figure recorded for that earlier quarter from its own filing.
